reason: The hypothesis relies on sluggish diffusion enabling selective Al/Cr oxidation, but the cited evidence does not directly support this mechanism. E3 states Cr diffuses outward faster than oxygen, contradicting the idea of retarded cation mobility. E1 and E2 show that in CrMnFeCoNi, Mn dominates oxidation and no Cr2O3 forms, which undermines the premise that Cr will selectively form a protective scale in HEAs. E4 only provides general background on HEA oxidation resistance. The key mechanistic premises are thus largely unsupported or contradicted by the cited passages.
